It sounds like you’re playing on the spelling—“dessert” (the sweet dish) versus “desert” (the arid landscape).  
If you’re asking about the **desert**, its typical hue is a sandy, beige‑tinted color—think light tan or ochre.  

If you really meant **dessert** (the sweet treat), its color can vary widely: chocolate desserts are brown, vanilla ones are white, fruit tarts can be pink or red, etc. In short, the “color of the dessert” depends on what dessert you’re looking at.
